import numpy as np

# Error replacement list
errors = [
    "23:16", 48, 19, 639, "2025-01-25", 63, 4, 13858, 29, 14, 120, "Mon",
    34, "Tue", 43, "2025-01-16", 72, "Sat", 47, "2025-01-14", None, 48,
    994, 301, 51, "21:58", 4, 551, "2025-01-09", "22:15", 44, "2025-01-08",
    313, 12, "2025-01-07", 368, None, None, 2937, None, 83, 6, "2025-01-04",
    33, "2025-01-03", 376, 2, 8, 53, 2, "Sun", "2024-12-30", None, 5661,
    33, 470, 2, 12, 595, 44, "Thu", 13
]

# Map ERROR positions to (row, col, replacement_value)
error_map = {
    (1, 6): errors[0],      # bed_time
    (1, 14): errors[1],     # coding_minutes
    (2, 7): errors[2],      # num_messages
    (2, 10): errors[3],     # calories_burned
    (3, 1): errors[4],      # date
    (4, 4): errors[5],      # exercise_minutes
    (5, 8): errors[6],      # num_emails
    (6, 2): errors[7],      # num_steps
    (7, 7): errors[8],      # num_messages
    (7, 14): errors[9],     # coding_minutes
    (8, 10): errors[10],    # calories_burned
    (8, 11): errors[11],    # weekday
    (9, 7): errors[12],     # num_messages
    (9, 11): errors[13],    # weekday
    (10, 17): errors[14],   # phone_screen_time
    (12, 1): errors[15],    # date
    (13, 3): errors[16],    # study_minutes
    (13, 11): errors[17],   # weekday
    (14, 8): errors[18],    # num_emails
    (14, 1): errors[19],    # date
    (15, 14): errors[20],   # coding_minutes
    (15, 16): errors[21],   # water_intake
}

# Row 8: Check what we get after replacement
print("Row 8 (2025-01-20) error replacements:")
print(f"  calories_burned (col 10): {error_map[(8, 10)]}")
print(f"  weekday (col 11): {error_map[(8, 11)]}")
print()

# Check condition for Row 8
calories = error_map[(8, 10)]
weekday = error_map[(8, 11)]
print(f"Row 8 condition check:")
print(f"  calories_burned < 800: {calories < 800}")
print(f"  weekday == 'Mon': {weekday == 'Mon'}")
print()

# Row 8 has:
# study_minutes = 98 (from original table)
# music_listening_minutes = 47 (from original table)

study_mins = 98
music_mins = 47

print(f"Row 8 values:")
print(f"  study_minutes: {study_mins}")
print(f"  music_listening_minutes: {music_mins}")
print()

# For single values
def stdev_single(values):
    if len(values) <= 1:
        return 0.0
    return float(np.std(values, ddof=1))

study_stdev = stdev_single([study_mins])
music_stdev = stdev_single([music_mins])

print(f"Standard deviations:")
print(f"  study_minutes stdev: {study_stdev}")
print(f"  music_listening_minutes stdev: {music_stdev}")
print()

diff = abs(music_stdev - study_stdev)
print(f"Absolute difference: {diff}")
print(f"Rounded to 2 decimal places: {diff:.2f}")
EOF
